blocks.text: “Harry Potter” author JK Rowling vowed to keep voicing her opposition to “trans activism” and financially supporting women taking legal action over their rights, in a new essay published Wednesday, Oct. 21. Rowling, 61, has been embroiled for years in controversy over the contentious issue and her stance that biological sex is immutable, incurring the wrath of activists and “Harry Potter” film stars. She denies being transphobic, arguing her concern is the impact transgender activism has on women’s rights and single-sex spaces for women. “I’ll continue to speak out, continue to use my money to help women who otherwise couldn’t afford […]...
